verdict.rationale: Lindy's docs describe a credentials store used for shell commands and code. A saved key is private to its owner until they choose to share it with everyone in the workspace. That covers central storage and team sharing, but access control is only all-or-nothing (private vs. whole workspace), not per-person or per-group. Missing for 10: granular per-user/role control over which credential each teammate can use, admin-level credential governance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
